items.title: Tata Motors launches Ultra, Red Dark Editions of Harrier, Safari in diesel; prices start at ₹23.84 lakh
items.summary: The company said the diesel Ultra and Ultra Red Dark variants of Harrier and Safari feature a 36.9 cm cinematic infotainment system by Harman, powered by Samsung Neo QLED, paired with Dolby Atmos audio.

items.title: Audi fears 'significant' tariff impact ahead of SUV launch in US
items.summary: US President ‌Donald Trump ⁠has threatened ⁠to raise tariffs on EU car imports to 25 per cent, arguing that the ​bloc has failed to comply with last year's US-EU trade agreement. The measures have ​not yet been confirmed, Rittersberger noted.
